decisions.reason: This core-adjacent track spotlight has had its own page for two years, which signals it has proven value in the system range, and it costs little to keep, so there is no case for abandoning it.
This ceiling luminaire has had sustained, dedicated presentation since 2023 and fits the established offer closely, so keeping it open is cheap and its results do not suggest weak value.
It was launched only in 2024 and is presented on its own page, so its prospects are still uncertain, and as a low-cost extension of the spotlight range it is worth keeping open.
This multi-outlet canopy is a cheap accessory that supports the modular system's flexibility, and with only one year of evidence the option should stay open.
The low-voltage canopy is a niche complement to the modular range with low carrying costs, and its value is still unresolved, so keeping it is justified.
Its weaker website presence, only a mention, hints at less commitment, but it is new and close to the core track range, so the low cost of keeping it outweighs dropping it prematurely.
